tags.LABEL: [no label]
tags.TITLE: We Are So Alike
tags.LYRICS:
[Verse 1]
We are so alike, are so alike
Me and you think alike like
Two people with one brain
We think alike and act the same
My mind's on fire, my heart's too cold
I can't feel any sensation in my bones
We are so alike, are so alike
I like you so much, please hold me tight

[Verse 2]
I am ice and you are lava
I'm too desperate to avoid the drama
And you're too angered to ignore
Your anger tends to keep me warm
I love you morе than I love my own life
I like you so much, wе are so alike
I wanna buy a house with you
On a hill with a far-out view

[Bridge]
Sometimes when I'm with you, it makes me wanna get better
And sometimes when I'm with you, I like to enjoy the weather
And sometimes seems to be enough to make me wanna get better
'Cause sometimes are all I have, and sometimes is better than never
Sometimes when I'm with you, it makes me wanna get better
And sometimes when I'm with you, I like to enjoy the weather
And sometimes seems to be enough to make me wanna get better
'Cause sometimes are all I have, and sometimes is better than never


[Verse 3]
We are so alike, are so alike
Let's buy ourselves a tangent bike
And ride around and enjoy the view
With fulfilling letters that are sent in June
The stars in the sky are all unequal
Those two by each other are just two people
I wanna buy a house with you
On a hill with a far-out view
